name: pin_diameter
expr: if(housing_diameter < 92 mm, 4 mm, if(housing_diameter < 124 mm, 5 mm, 6 mm))

name: disc_profile_area
expr: pi * (pin_circle_radius^2 + pin_count * eccentricity^2) - equidistant * 2 * pi * pin_circle_radius * (1 + shortening^2 / 4 + shortening^4 / 64 + shortening^6 / 256 + 25 * shortening^8 / 16384 + 49 * shortening^10 / 65536 + 441 * shortening^12 / 1048576) + pi * equidistant^2

name: ring_room
expr: smallest_pin / 2 + if(pin_rollers, roller_wall, 0 mm) + fit_clearance + disc_bore_radius + smallest_pin + 2 * hole_clearance + 2 * web_min

name: housing_diameter_min
expr: max(motors[motor].smallest_drive, 2 * (max(ring_radius_needed, screw_radius_needed) + housing_wall + pocket_gap + smallest_pin / 2 + if(pin_rollers, roller_wall, 0 mm)))

name: output_row
expr: if(bearings[8].outside / 2 <= output_limit && bearings[8].bore / 2 <= hub_limit, 8, if(bearings[7].outside / 2 <= output_limit && bearings[7].bore / 2 <= hub_limit, 7, if(bearings[6].outside / 2 <= output_limit && bearings[6].bore / 2 <= hub_limit, 6, if(bearings[5].outside / 2 <= output_limit && bearings[5].bore / 2 <= hub_limit, 5, if(bearings[4].outside / 2 <= output_limit && bearings[4].bore / 2 <= hub_limit, 4, 3)))))

name: depth_max
expr: max(depth_min, min(depth_ceiling, 100 * shortening_for_undercut, 100 * eccentricity_limit * pin_count / pin_circle_radius))

name: plate_radius
expr: min(pin_circle_radius - contact_radius - 1 mm, hole_circle_radius + pin_radius + 3 mm)

x: (pin_circle_radius * cos(t) - eccentricity * cos(pin_count * t)) - equidistant * (pin_circle_radius * cos(t) - eccentricity * pin_count * cos(pin_count * t)) / sqrt(pin_circle_radius^2 + (eccentricity * pin_count)^2 - 2 * pin_circle_radius * eccentricity * pin_count * cos(lobe_count * t))
y: (pin_circle_radius * sin(t) - eccentricity * sin(pin_count * t)) - equidistant * (pin_circle_radius * sin(t) - eccentricity * pin_count * sin(pin_count * t)) / sqrt(pin_circle_radius^2 + (eccentricity * pin_count)^2 - 2 * pin_circle_radius * eccentricity * pin_count * cos(lobe_count * t))

reduction
label: Reduction ratio
description: How many input turns give one output turn (opposite direction). The disc gets this many lobes and the ring one pin more. Odd ratios only, so two identical discs fit half a lobe apart.

name: housing_diameter
label: Housing outer diameter
description: The drive's overall diameter. The pin circle, the pins, the bearings and the lobes all follow from it; a bigger housing allows a higher ratio.

name: motor
label: Motor
description: The stepper the drive bolts to: mounting screws, pilot and shaft come from this row (NEMA ICS 16 sizes as most stepper makers build them).

name: input_angle
label: Turn the input
description: Drag it: the eccentric turns, the disc orbits and rolls round the pins, and the output turns the other way by this angle divided by the reduction.

name: disc_count
label: Discs
description: Two identical discs half a lobe apart balance the forces of the orbiting disc; one is the simple printable start.

name: lobe_depth
label: Lobe depth
description: How deep the lobes run, as a percentage of a cusped lobe (the shortening ratio K in the cycloid literature). Deeper lobes tolerate print error better but press harder on the pins and bearing; the form limits it so the lobes do not undercut and everything still fits.

name: pin_rollers
label: Rollers on the ring pins
description: Free-turning sleeves on the steel pins, which reduce the sliding between the lobes and the pins (the pin circle shrinks a little to make room).

name: fit_clearance
label: Running clearance
description: The gap between the disc's lobes and the pins, and the backlash you allow for: too small and printed parts bind, too large and the drive rattles. Tune it for your printer.

name: show
label: Show
description: The drive with part of the housing open, closed, or the parts laid out flat in their print orientation (export this for a 3MF of every part).
choices: Print layout: all printed parts on the bed

title: Cycloidal drive
author: 3DCraft Jigs
description: A printable single-stage cycloidal reducer for a NEMA stepper. Choose the reduction and the housing diameter: the pins, the lobes, the eccentricity and the trochoid disc profile follow, the form refuses a ratio that would undercut the lobes or crowd the pins, and dragging Turn the input orbits the disc and turns the output by the true ratio. To export: set Show to Print layout, then File > Export, The model as 3MF for every printed part in its print orientation on the bed (select a body to export one part). To buy: ring and output pins are steel dowels (diameter and lengths in the outputs); each disc rides on one ball bearing, the output on two, all with the sizes in the outputs, and the eccentric's top on one 61800 (10 x 19 x 5 mm); M3 screws and heat-set inserts close the cover and fix the flange.
